newsitem.title: CHINA: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - March 11.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Shanghai newspapers - March 11.

text.p: Following is a summary of major political and business stories in local newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Shanghai. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.
- SHANGHAI SECURITIES NEWS - Value of shares in the listed firms composed of Shanghai's 30-company blue-chip index has more than doubled since the start of last year.
- Commentary urges learning from recent financial crises in several emerging markets including Albania's illegal money-raising case, and being more aware of risk.
- BUSINESS NEWS - A researcher in China's Agricultural Sciences Academy claims China made a clone calf in February 1996, well ahead of the cloned sheep created by British scientists.
- Executive deputy major Chen Liangyu urges more work to be done in expanding industrial output to ensure Shanghai's target of economic growth for this year to be fulfilled.
- Guangdong's Weida Company, a large national paper-making firm, will take over the poorly-managed Limin Paper Plant in Shanghai, which has been on the brink of bankruptcy.
